name: minecart-detector-rail
comment: WP-2.4b. A straight rail along x at z = 0, y = 61, x = -6..6: a detector rail at x = 0, a powered rail at x = 1, plain rails elsewhere, a stone wall at (7, 61, 0). A minecart (id 0) spawned at x = -2.5 with set_motion 0.3 rolls onto the detector rail, which finds it (BlockDetectorRail.onEntityCollidedWithBlock from Entity.moveEntity, the cart in hand; getEntitiesWithinAABB(EntityMinecart)), switches bit 3 on and powers its neighbours: the powered rail turns on (t = 8) and boosts the cart by 0.06 a tick while it crosses it. The cart then coasts into the wall (isCollidedHorizontally, motion zeroed by moveEntity) and stays. The detector's scheduled tick (20) finds no cart and turns both rails off (t = 27). rng_state, entity_state, the two rail blocks, power at the powered rail and the scheduled ticks every tick.
